tool-checkpoint: tool-checkpoint: The current-session assistant follows common governance rule 9 for this input's PreToolUse checkpoint. Display it once per input and again only when the recorded checkpoint state changes. Every tool call is still checked and audited.
terminal-routing: The current-session assistant classifies this input before calling tools. For an explanation or clarification answerable from supplied conversation alone, the current-session assistant uses direct-response or clarification-only and does not read files, access the ledger or register a response-route. The intake hook and strict audit still run. A correction or status question during continuing authorized work stays normal unless the user stops or replaces that work. A new completion judgment requires its own evidence. Every agent call, including governance and Ghost-ALICE Autopilot recording, counts against explicit user tool limits.
session-intent: session-intent-analyzer: The hook records digest-only intake for the native session. On a normal route, the current-session assistant follows session-intent-analyzer to add only material semantic changes through the exact receipt. Intent records must exclude raw prompts, conversation/tool output, system instructions and secrets.
task-router: hook-reminder: For normal work after exact session-intent intake, the current-session assistant follows task-router to select work and required skills and register the Core response-route. Tool-free terminal answers follow common governance First-Entry Contract.
